nav.privacyBadge: Private & Isolated. Zero third-party tracker data sharing.

landing.title: Understand Your Health Records with Complete Clarity
landing.subtitle: Securely parse medical lab reports, decode prescriptions, track daily medication schedules, and get grounded explanations in English, Telugu, and Hindi.
landing.feature1Desc: Upload PDF or image lab results to view structured tests alongside source laboratory reference ranges.
landing.feature2Desc: Extract medicine names and dosages with honest uncertainty flags. We never guess illegible handwriting.
landing.feature3Desc: Never miss a dose. Track active medications with timezone-aware daily reminders and log adherence.
landing.feature4Desc: Complete native interfaces and medical explanations in English, Telugu (తెలుగు), and Hindi (हिन्दी).
landing.feature5Desc: Locate real nearby verified hospitals, pharmacies, and clinics powered by open mapping without fabricated hours.
landing.feature6Desc: Compile confirmed observations and targeted clinical questions to maximize your consultation time.

reports.title: Medical Lab Reports
reports.subtitle: Upload and review laboratory test documents. All extracted values require your confirmation.
reports.uploadBoxTitle: Drag & drop report or click to browse
reports.uploadBoxSubtitle: Supports PDF, PNG, and JPEG up to 10MB
reports.noObservations: No test values found. You can add values directly from the document.
reports.aiNotice: Values were extracted via document processing. Check each number against the original file before confirming.

prescriptions.title: Prescription Reader & Decoder
prescriptions.subtitle: Convert prescription notes into structured schedules. Handwriting uncertainty is explicitly flagged.
prescriptions.handwritingAlert: Handwriting Caution: Clinical handwriting can be ambiguous. Unclear handwriting is flagged as unreadable rather than guessed.
prescriptions.summaryUnavailable: No readable summary could be generated.
prescriptions.uncertainText: Some handwriting may be unclear. Verify every medicine and instruction against the original with a pharmacist or clinician.
prescriptions.analysisUnavailable: The document is saved, but an analysis summary is not available. Check AI configuration and review the original document.
prescriptions.analysisDisclaimer: This is an AI-assisted reading, not a verified prescription. Confirm all details against the original before use.

reminders.title: Medication Schedules & Reminders
reminders.subtitle: Track your prescribed medicines, set daily dose slots, and log taken/skipped doses.
reminders.noMedications: No medications currently registered. Add your medicines or upload a prescription.

timeline.title: Unified Health Timeline
timeline.subtitle: Chronological provenance of all your lab tests, prescriptions, doctor summaries, and dose logs.
timeline.emptyTimeline: Your timeline is empty. Upload a report or add a medicine to get started.

findCare.title: Find Verified Nearby Care
findCare.subtitle: Search actual hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies using live OpenStreetMap geographical data.
findCare.searchPrompt: Enter city or area (e.g. Hyderabad, Vijayawada, New Delhi)
findCare.noResults: No facilities found within 5km of this location. Try expanding your search area.

doctorSummary.title: Doctor Visit Preparation Summary
doctorSummary.subtitle: Prepare a concise, organized summary of your confirmed health records and questions for your clinician.

appointments.title: Appointments & Follow-ups
appointments.subtitle: Keep track of scheduled clinic visits and diagnostic follow-ups.
